description: The Escouade settings a project's team shares through its repository.

engine.description: The harness the project's new agents and tickets run on.

agents_from_target.description: Replaced by worktrees.base: true reads as target, false as head.

on_approve.description: What approving a ticket does with its branch.

on_conflict.description: What a merge conflict does: ask, have the agent resolve it, or give up.

remove_worktree.description: A ticket's worktree is removed once it is done.

target_branch.description: Where tickets merge: the base of their branch and of their pull request.

test_command.description: The project's tests. Needs the user's approval.

tests_before_approve.description: The tests run again before a ticket is approved.

commit_mode.description: Who writes the commits asked from the files panel: the agent, or the app with a proposed message.

conventional_commits.description: Commit messages in the Conventional Commits form.

launch.description: The commands that launch the project (« Lancement »). Need the user's approval.

cwd.description: A folder relative to the repository (or the worktree).

shell.description: pwsh, powershell, bash, zsh, wsl…; the system's default one when empty or not found.

version.description: The version of this file's format (1 today).

at_first_message.description: A new agent's worktree is made at its first message, its branch and its folder under the name it is given then (true when absent).

base.description: The branch a new agent's worktree starts from, its base: head (the branch the project's folder is on, when absent), target (the board's target branch) or a branch's name (local, or remote such as origin/main: through the local branch that tracks it). A branch named head or target is written refs/heads/<name>.

copy.description: Untracked files copied into every new worktree (glob patterns).

dir.description: Where the worktrees go, relative to the repository (empty: .claude/worktrees).

per_agent.description: Each new agent works in a worktree of its own.

setup.description: Run in every new worktree before its agent starts. Needs the user's approval.
